scenes.title: Sela's offer at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn offers a daylight boat trip for two silver and says she will return at first light. She claims Saltmere flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago and repeats her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and hymn pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement; the search reveals nothing further, and Oren takes two damage from the air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the GM notes the choir clock is three of six.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at daytime low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
